decisions.reason: The camera sits close to the firm's core space-heritage offer and has its own web page, so results are likely at or above aspiration and there is no trigger for problemistic search.

This modular camera line with several models fits the strategic move toward flexible, compact sensors for small satellites, and its long space development cycles mean the firm's slack lets it carry the line while early results come in.

Space situational awareness extends the firm's established offer into a growing segment, and although results are more uncertain, a large firm's slack and EU and agency funding make keeping it the satisficing choice.

The miniaturized LiDAR is only mentioned on the website, which suggests early market traction, but it builds on the firm's docking and navigation know-how and matches the miniaturization strategy, so slack supports keeping it rather than dropping it within a year.
